title: Pelican band and the trumpeters Dusen and Clem
summary: Recollections of the Pelican band, Frankie Dusen, John Pendleton and a one-eyed trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: And that Pelican band from uptown there, what you call them, playing trumpet there, Eddie, and they had a, what's the name, uh, it was Frankie Duesen. Frankie Duesen.

Oh, yeah. Well, that was the town, that was, uh, that was Ragtime band. Yeah. That was Ragtime band. They had the Frank's, ah, alright. I think that was a good one. That's when Frank takes the band, and he left John Pendleton, well, John Pendleton, you know, he could play a kind of style of music. No. Well, I had another fella. His name was Ned. Yeah. Yeah. That's Terry's band, but men like to travel around, so he went away. See, Frank's taken up on Edwark Clem.

Edwark Clem, well, that's the one I was talking about on the trumpet, Edwark Clem. Oh, yeah. He was another fella that had one eye, too. He used to wear black glasses all the time. You couldn't tell it. My glasses are such an app. Yeah. But he was a good trumpet player, though. Oh, yeah.
Yeah. Yeah, Joe Welch was playing drums. Oh, Joe Welch? Yeah. Joe Welch played drums.
